summary: Modine Manufacturing filed an 8-K to report entry into Amendment No. 2 to its Sixth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment permits the separation, disposition, and spin-off of its Performance Technologies business via the PT Transaction, including an Agreement and Plan of Merger. It allows a newly formed escrow subsidiary to incur indebtedness for the PT Transaction, with proceeds held in escrow pending consummation. The amendment revises negative covenants for permitted investments and asset transfers and mandates a mandatory prepayment of credit agreement loans with 100% of net proceeds upon release from escrow. This is a financing arrangement to facilitate a planned spin-off, not the spin-off event itself. Watch for consummation of the PT Transaction.
